intro.title: One-Word Story
text: Make a circle. Read the opener together.
Go round: one word each, building the story.

intro.title: Follow the beat
text: Every beep, the next person says ONE word.
Too slow? The circle helps you.

intro.title: Keep it right
text: The story must make sense and be correct.

intro.title: Time's up!
text: The last person finishes the sentence.
Then one person retells the whole story (30 s).
